subject: Execution
notes: kb/Work PB64 T1 (2026-08-19): at run-unit activation the user default (DETERMINATION L2 — COBOL_USER_LOCALE, else the process culture, else the root) becomes the current locale for every category. The implementor half (L3): a locale set by a non-COBOL module is NOT observed (the state is read from CultureInfo ONCE, at activation); a SET … TO USER-DEFAULT is how a program takes the user default.
